attribute_fields.COMMENTS: New Jersey state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure per NJ tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "New Jersey Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.nj_personal_exemption sub 0 max /nj_taxable_income xdef
0 /nj_tax xdef
nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_1_limit_single min result.nj_bracket_1_rate mul nj_tax add /nj_tax xdef
nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_1_limit_single gt { nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_2_limit_single min result.nj_bracket_1_limit_single sub 0 max result.nj_bracket_2_rate_single mul nj_tax add /nj_tax xdef } if
nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_2_limit_single gt { nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_3_limit_single min result.nj_bracket_2_limit_single sub 0 max result.nj_bracket_3_rate_single mul nj_tax add /nj_tax xdef } if
nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_3_limit_single gt { nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_4_limit_single min result.nj_bracket_3_limit_single sub 0 max result.nj_bracket_4_rate_single mul nj_tax add /nj_tax xdef } if
nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_4_limit_single gt { nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_5_limit_single min result.nj_bracket_4_limit_single sub 0 max result.nj_bracket_5_rate_single mul nj_tax add /nj_tax xdef } if
nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_5_limit_single gt { nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_6_limit_single min result.nj_bracket_5_limit_single sub 0 max result.nj_bracket_6_rate_single mul nj_tax add /nj_tax xdef } if
nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_6_limit_single gt { nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_6_limit_single sub result.nj_bracket_7_rate mul nj_tax add /nj_tax xdef } if
nj_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"New Jersey tax (single) calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

result.agi result.nj_personal_exemption 2 mul sub 0 max /nj_taxable_income xdef
0 /nj_tax xdef
nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_1_limit_joint min result.nj_bracket_1_rate mul nj_tax add /nj_tax xdef
nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_1_limit_joint gt { nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_2_limit_joint min result.nj_bracket_1_limit_joint sub 0 max result.nj_bracket_2_rate_joint mul nj_tax add /nj_tax xdef } if
nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_2_limit_joint gt { nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_3_limit_joint min result.nj_bracket_2_limit_joint sub 0 max result.nj_bracket_3_rate_joint mul nj_tax add /nj_tax xdef } if
nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_3_limit_joint gt { nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_4_limit_joint min result.nj_bracket_3_limit_joint sub 0 max result.nj_bracket_4_rate_joint mul nj_tax add /nj_tax xdef } if
nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_4_limit_joint gt { nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_5_limit_joint min result.nj_bracket_4_limit_joint sub 0 max result.nj_bracket_5_rate_joint mul nj_tax add /nj_tax xdef } if
nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_5_limit_joint gt { nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_6_limit_joint min result.nj_bracket_5_limit_joint sub 0 max result.nj_bracket_6_rate_joint mul nj_tax add /nj_tax xdef } if
nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_6_limit_joint gt { nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_7_limit_joint min result.nj_bracket_6_limit_joint sub 0 max result.nj_bracket_7_rate_joint mul nj_tax add /nj_tax xdef } if
nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_7_limit_joint gt { nj_taxable_income result.nj_bracket_7_limit_joint sub result.nj_bracket_8_rate_joint mul nj_tax add /nj_tax xdef } if
nj_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"New Jersey tax (MFJ) calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: New Jersey military retirement pay exclusion. Full exemption for all military retirement income (Group B). MSRRA compliant. SCRA compliant. SBP payments fully exempt.

initial_action.action_postfix: "NJ Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Full exclusion - 100% of military retirement pay excluded from NJ taxable income
action_details.action_postfix:
taxpayer.military_retirement_pay get /result.nj_military_retirement_exclusion xdef
result.nj_subtractions get result.nj_military_retirement_exclusion get add /result.nj_subtractions xdef
"NJ Military Retirement Exclusion (Full): $" result.nj_military_retirement_exclusion get cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No military retirement pay - no exclusion
action_details.action_postfix: 0 /result.nj_military_retirement_exclusion xdef "NJ Military Retirement Exclusion: None (no military retirement pay)" job.audit_trail swap addto
